programs.title: Dhol
programs.desc: Four young loafers wish to simplify their life by wooing a loaded heiress. Unfortunately, there's only one rich girl in the neighbourhood. The boys scamper to woo her first, not knowing that their efforts would lead them right into a murder mystery.

programs.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programs.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.

programs.title: Dangerous Ishq
programs.desc: A supermodel experiences visions of her past lives while trying to save her kidnapped boyfriend.
